recognize_zh: 一群圍繞巨噬細胞的紅血球前驅細胞（erythroblastic island）都偏大，核染色質呈細點狀、開放的篩網樣，而細胞質已有灰藍到粉紅的血紅素化，核質發育不同步，是巨母紅血球性貧血（megaloblastic anemia）的特徵。
features: Erythroblastic island of enlarged erythroid precursors clustered around a central macrophage
Round nuclei with finely granular, open 'sieve-like' chromatin
Moderate grey-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm, more mature than the nuclei (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Central macrophage cytoplasm with vacuoles and phagocytosed debris
Adjacent granulocytic cells, including a segmented neutrophil at the lower left
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island composed of enlarged erythroid precursors surrounding a vacuolated macrophage. The precursors have round nuclei with finely stippled, open chromatin that appears immature relative to their grey-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Scattered granulocytic cells are present at the edges. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: MDS megaloblastoid cells usually show nuclear budding, internuclear bridging, multinucleation and ring sideroblasts, and B12/folate levels are normal.
Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows normal-sized precursors with progressively condensed chromatin synchronous with cytoplasmic hemoglobinization.
Leukemic proerythroblasts are predominantly immature with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, not a maturing population with asynchrony.
